correctness.rationale: The frame operator after one atomic deletion is S_-=S-m theta_{F0,F0}. Positive congruence yields S^-1/2 S_- S^-1/2=I-theta_{u,u} with u=sqrt(m)S^-1/2F0 and ||u||²=ell. Positivity forces ell<=1, while bounded invertibility, hence the lower frame bound, holds exactly when ell<1. At ell=1, direct substitution gives S_- S^-1F0=0 and F0 nonzero; the atom must have m>0. Thus any measurable set containing omega0 has positive measure. The source's proposed null set contains the atom, so its measure cannot be 0.
